description:
You are an instructional coordinator sourcing Zero Textbook Cost (ZTC) materials for a Fall pilot program. Your goal is to locate three specific textbooks on OpenStax (https://openstax.org), organize them, and extract their metadata.

Target Textbooks:
1. "Psychology 2e" (Social Sciences)
2. "Calculus Volume 1" (Math)
3. "Microbiology" (Science)

Requirements:
1. Navigate to OpenStax.org and locate the page for each book.
2. Create a Firefox bookmark folder named "Fall Curriculum OER" and bookmark the main landing page for each of the three books in this folder.
3. Download the PDF version of "Psychology 2e" to ~/Downloads/ (ensure the file is saved).
4. Create a curriculum metadata report at ~/Documents/oer_report.json containing details for all three books. Use the exact JSON structure below:

{
  "curriculum_pilot": "Fall 2024",
  "resources": [
    {
      "subject": "Social Sciences",
      "title": "Psychology 2e",
      "isbn_13_digital": "<find on page>",
      "license": "<find on page>",
      "authors": ["<first author>", "<second author>", "<etc>"]
    },
    ...
  ]
}
